name: 16-bent-arm-calibration-baseline-clamp
description: Simulated, 30 fps, 1 px noise: the user calibrates with bent arms (holding a 135° elbow through the 3-2-1), then straightens to the real top (d ≈ −0.09) and rests there: the top baseline hTop adapts upward until it hits its clamp, hTopCalibrated × (1 + baselineMaxDrift) = +8 %. Then 3 full reps (80°) count. targetReps 30.
